recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-15653 unless a future work group decision revisits the later logical-model relaxation.
issue_request: FHIR-15653 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core StructureDefinition technical correction for STU3 asking to change sdf-3 to element.all(definition.exists() and min.exists() and max.exists()) because the prior expression incorrectly assumed non-empty values converted to boolean true.
initial_application: Jira comments record svn revision 13363 and then "already fixed". This git checkout has no FHIR-15653-tagged source commit, but historical release3 source still shows element.all(definition and min and max), while release4/release4b history and current source show the corrected .exists() expression.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active structuredefinition=StructureDefinition entry, so source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml is in current build scope. Later Published issue FHIR-34307 intentionally relaxed sdf-3 for logical models in R5, and commit cb57c390ab490af5018e01f60f27c5f395e282ca added the %resource.kind = 'logical' or prefix while preserving the .exists() checks. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community decision for FHIR-15653.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active invariant is %resource.kind = 'logical' or element.all(definition.exists() and min.exists() and max.exists()), which satisfies FHIR-15653 while retaining later FHIR-34307 behavior.
